title: BBS The Documentary: Episode 1 of 8: BAUD (The Beginning)
summary: The first episode of Jason Scott's eight-part BBS documentary, covering the predecessors and beginnings of the dial-up bulletin board system. It includes interviews with pioneers such as Ward Christensen and Randy Suess, who created the first dial-up BBS in 1978.
why: HN commenters recommend the series as the definitive history of BBS culture and its Fidonet roots, especially for nostalgia and the origins of the demoscene.

quote.text: He also gave us the brilliant BBS: The Documentary
